explication: Bambu Studio is a desktop 3D-printing slicer. Its main user workflow is to prepare models on managed plates, configure geometry and print settings, slice them into G-code, then inspect or send the result for printing. The README also describes remote monitoring and control; the tree includes device-management and filament-manager code supporting that product area. Core slicing and GUI wiring were not sampled, so those paths use existing enclosing directories and the graph shows only the documented workflow at a subsystem level.
